hypothesis: Check omitted raw predictors rather than assuming all 186 excluded fields are noise.
selector: Training-only chi-square association, numeric decile bins, categorical exact levels; Benjamini-Hochberg FDR .05; maximum 8 fields; binned one-hot additions to frozen reference features.
gate: Both seeds delta > .001 and paired 95% CI lower > 0
stop: If no screened choice improves by .001, stop before full outer training.
history: Sequential research, not an independent blind test; raw IDs excluded; no Kaggle labels or new measured Kaggle score.
